name: afterlaunch-skills
description: Growth skills for a founder's agent, from the AfterLaunch team. reddit-desk: find, judge and draft Reddit replies inside each subreddit's own rules and budgets, never posting. session-recap: rebuild your memory of a work session in three answers and, with AfterLaunch connected, reconcile the session against your growth record so the effort stops evaporating.
